games.name: bridger: WESTERN (CMOON)
games.desc:
Mankind in their expansion west have settled within Ridge. B Valley, a grueling and untouched wilderness rumored to hold an ancient curse. Beasts hunt and forces beyond mortal reach skulk these grounds, their chaos trapped and anchored by those who came long before them.

Your place within the valley is yet to be decided,  whatever path you choose to walk down danger remains a constant.

Q - Quick dash 
W+W - Sprint 
R - Reload (With Weapon)
M1 - Fire (With weapon)
